blocks.text: MANILA – The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) is exploring the use of nature-based solutions alongside concrete structures for flood control in flood-prone areas, particularly in Pampanga and Bulacan. DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon on Wednesday said the department is studying the use of hybrid structures for flood mitigation projects. “I think we need to take a broader look at how things are being done elsewhere. Let’s look at countries that have already successfully implemented this,” he said in an interview on the sidelines of a meeting with officials of the department, Haskoning Phils.
